target:jope-parallel/test/bounded_launch.scope: W7-T03/T04 delivery half, default features: the per-rank launch record is exactly what the frozen plan derives, workers load only the frozen plan and record, the launcher execs with exactly CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES set to the planned UUID (empty for a CPU rank) and nothing else, a worker refuses any other visibility, and the NCCL bootstrap comes only from this plan's verified admission (forged, replayed, wrong-attempt, foreign-plan, wrong-rank and wrong-length bootstraps refused). target:jope-parallel/test/bounded_run_re.scope: W7-T05 same-host process fixture: rank processes (re-executions of the test binary) join the authenticated rendezvous; kill one rank, sever control, cancel, expire a grant and restart the coordinator; whole-group drain, reconciled dispositions, single commit and no orphan process. One host, one boot; not the three-host proof and no numerical work.

target:jope-parallel/test/bounded_smartc.scope: W7-T05/T07 same-host multi-process fixture through the real supervisor: per rank a real unprivileged embedded SmartCluster daemon (this workspace's own scqd, which the fixture never builds: W7-D5, full-default's workspace test build produces it and full-lane.sh checks it is built and records its digest before the tests run; absent, the fixture fails at once with the build command) runs the production jope-native-loop command line as the test-only jope-native-loop-fixture executable (the participant observes the checked-in fixture host and its own /proc/self/exe, whose digest the plan pins) as a trusted-service job, and a real jope-native-loop agent process (the product binary) serves that daemon over pinned TLS to the coordinator's remote supervisor; the whole group commits once, a SIGKILLed rank and a cancel drain the whole group, a SIGKILLed coordinator CLI is restarted and reconciles through the same agents, no orphan process, and a host supervisor acts only on its own plan's jobs. W7-D1: a participant proves before any work that it is its planned job's leader (job environment, control-socket parent = pinned daemon, the daemon's live record of attempt, tenant, plan, dispatch, service and arguments); outside SmartCluster, forged environment, impostor daemon, wrong dispatch, other plan, replayed attempt and other tenant are refused. target:jope-parallel/test/bounded_traini.scope: W7-D2 CPU fixtures up to the device boundary (default features; no GPU, NCCL or device): a rank whose frozen plan selects training writes run.json from the plan alone (partition v2 for three ranks, corpus and parent digests, step window, deadline) after checking the plan, its launch record and the admitted NCCL bootstrap against each other; another rank's or plan's bootstrap, a forged launch record, a shared nccl.id (the train_controlled rendezvous) in the launch or run directory, a reused launch directory, another plan's run.json, altered inputs and a parent at another step are refused; a training selection must pin its corpus, parent, cadence and GPUs; a default-build participant refuses a training plan before any work. target:jope-parallel/test/bounded_transp.scope: W7-T04/T07 cross-host transport on loopback TCP with in-test self-signed Ed25519 certificates: TLS 1.3 with mutual certificate identity pinned by the plan; wrong, expired and not-yet-valid certificates refused both ways; oversize frames refused before the body; silent peers time out; replayed TLS bytes, duplicated or skipped delivery ids and a hello replayed over a fresh authenticated connection refused; the rendezvous admits only ranks whose TLS peer presents their planned host certificate; W7-D4: a rotated host or coordinator certificate is refused under the old plan and admitted only by a new plan that pins it.
